decisions.reason: The Trivital supplement range is a publicly launched brand family that the firm has kept extending, so it is visibly committed to it and dropping the range would write off that investment.
The skin and hair supplement was promoted as new in pharmacies as part of the committed Trivital line and is cheap to keep alongside its sister products.
The joint supplement was announced as a new Trivital product and was given its own page, which signals public commitment to the brand extension.
The immune supplement was the most recently publicized addition to the Trivital line, and its seasonal demand makes weak results easy to attribute to temporary causes.

The 2018 valsartan problem was an industry-wide contamination issue that can be treated as temporary, and generics are a core part of the firm's portfolio, so management is likely to persist despite the setback.
The OTC triptan required regulatory and marketing investment and fits the announced push into consumer health, so dropping it would expose the earlier decision as a mistake.
